info.title: Directory API
info.description:
## Why use the Directory Management API?

When developing your products and services you often need to work with others
and also manage your data and access to core services and data based on your organizational
hierarchy.

* Define your organization hierarchy and directory
* Apply roles and groups to your hierarchy
* Add users and permissions to your directory to manage access to services.

## What can you do with the Directory API?

Use the Directory API to manage your access, roles, groups, and organizational hierarchy. Define your
sales teams, marketing teams, and other teams to power permissions and insights.

* Provide a view of your organization.
* Link people to groups, roles, and permissions.
* Enable fine grained access to custom applications and services
* Integration with OIDC and Identity platform.
-----
